headline: Vivara Shares Plunge After Third-Quarter Financial Report
summary: Vivara shares suffered a sharp decline on the stock exchange following the release of the jewelry group's third-quarter performance results.
why: Earnings reports that miss market expectations frequently trigger rapid equity repricing in consumer retail segments.

impacts.name: Vivara
impacts.why: Disappointing third-quarter financial results led directly to a sell-off in company shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted negatively to Vivara's reported third-quarter financial performance, causing a sharp drop in share value.
